decision: Best tested useful high-precision regions on the frozen owner library; no claim of universal optimality or listener ground truth

directional_compact.update: uniform weights inside cap; Epanechnikov density profile

hdbscan.metric: Euclidean chord distance on exact centered unit fused vectors

noise: Never group all noise points together; remove before centroid collection; no forcing to nearest region

audit.source: existing anonymous MOSS excerpts; all non-silence; deterministic central 10 seconds
audit.checks: finite noncollapsed vectors; same-track other-excerpt retrieval versus random; repeat determinism. Exclude encoder if same-track median cross-excerpt percentile <0.8
audit.development: artists SHA256(normalized artist) first byte <128, excerpt position0
audit.holdout: remaining artists, excerpt position1; never used for tuning
audit.measure: For each audited assigned track, mean CLAP cosine percentile of its different-artist region peers relative to all eligible different-artist audit tracks; then mean across tracks. Report same-artist-inclusive sensitivity, lower quartile and group coverage.
audit.warning: Proxy for acoustic cohesion, not human correctness. Nonrandom audio availability and prior MOSS selection bias. Artist-only regions cannot win the cross-artist primary score.

selection.eligibility: converged; >=55% full-library final assignment; >=45% of development audit tracks have >=2 different-artist region peers; 8..45 final regions; largest <=30% library
selection.rule: Highest development cross-artist cohesion mean; within 0.01 choose highest full-library coverage. Pick per-family and global before holdout disclosure.
selection.coverage_policy: 55% is an explicitly assumed usefulness floor; also report Pareto at >=35% and >=70%, never equate low coverage with incorrectness
selection.holdout: Confirm direction against current baseline on shared eligible anchors; bootstrap paired anchor differences, 2000 draws, seed20261014; report both own covered population and common anchors
selection.stability: Top per-family selected configuration: delete10% rows seeds3,17,41, refit incl recenter; ARI on commonly retained raw clusters and pair retention; noise separately

limits: No Android performance claim, no new cloud job, no production code change. No MOSS ratings used.
